notes.title: Fishy Dungeon Delving is going to free forever starting this Friday!
notes.content:
I have had a chat with a great Steam support person and we worked out the details to get this game made free forever. (For real this time) This will be happening this Friday, March 18th 2022, just a little bit shy of the 3 year anniversary of this game.

Thank you to everyone who has tried this game out. I know it has not lived up to the hype, and it may not realistically ever do so. I will truly never forget the hours I spent making that silly fish flop right though. Sorry for disappointing you.

The last few years have had many setbacks and time conflicts, but I really do plan to make 2022 the year I give this game some much needed TLC.

notes.title: Fishy Dungeon Delving Going Free To Play and coming Updates
notes.content:
[h1]Hello players!
[/h1]
It has been a long time hasn't it.
We have not forgotten our fishy or goblin friend.

[h2]Fishy Dungeon Delving is going to become free to play.
[/h2]We realize that it would be best for all players and the company if this game went free to play.
We will be making this game free to play in two weeks!

We also plan on adding this game to other platforms such as itch.io for free as well in the next few weeks.

[h2]FDD will be getting an update! ːsteamhappyː[/h2]
For those who have been patiently waiting for an update it will be arriving by the end of March!
The coming update will feature improvements to the existing levels such as.
[list]
[*] Air vents/lifts will be replacing previous vertical shortcuts.
[*] Tongue timer will be reworked with a system that makes it so you have to wait for the tongue to be pulled in before you can fire it again. I think you know what that means...
[*] More general improvements will also be added.
[/list]

[h3]Future Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Boosts will now be more meaningful, except for the wings which are perfect!
[*] Planned New levels!
[*] Graphical tweaks!
[*] More general improvements
[/list]
